prior_summary: A learned DDPM action policy conditioned on a causal red-object-relative representation: TCP, blue support cube, and red/blue goals are encoded relative to the current red cube so the unstack lift is not learned only as an absolute joint path.
applicable_conditions: Use when the red cube is the top cube in an initially centered red-on-blue stack, red_pose and blue_pose are available in world coordinates, the gripper is initially open or can still form a top grasp, and the Panda TCP is approaching from above the workspace. The model covers the full expanded slice from initial approach through the shared raised-and-starting-lateral-carry transition.
termination_guidance: Continue until causal observations show a closed/pinched gripper, red_pose lifted well above blue_pose, blue_pose still near the table, and the TCP/red pair beginning lateral travel toward the red goal. Transfer can occur in the overlap once red z is roughly above 0.15 m and the fingers remain near the closed demonstrated aperture; later transfer around 0.30 m red height is also supported.
limitations: The policy is still a learned joint-target diffusion model with no analytic IK, no contact proof, and no recovery controller. It is trained on successful top grasps in a narrow stack-translation range and may fail under large yaw, side contacts, missed grasps, or disturbed blue blocks.

config.auxiliary_future_descriptor: learned MLP predicts normalized future TCP-minus-red, red-minus-blue, red-goal-minus-red, blue drift, and finger aperture from the denoised action estimate and condition embedding
